conflict_rules: Higher authority files override lower authority files.
At the same authority level, use the newest created_at_utc.
For evidence issues, raw archives and manifests override reports.
For current phase issues, TASK_STATE.json overrides old reports.
For system boundaries, SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.json overrides old archived files.
When compressed context conflicts with source manifests, source manifests win.
When BOOT.md conflicts with SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.json, SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.json wins and BOOT.md must be rebuilt.
